title: 第3章 意外的惊喜第4章 孩子你礼貌吗
slug: 漂亮后妈要翻身我在七零养崽崽
content_zh:
刚才听著屋子里有动静，他以为这个女人过一会肯定就走了，没想到她竟然打水来给自己擦脸。
不过他没说话，只是沉默看著她。
一时的兴起对他来说並没有什么意外的地方，这要看她能坚持多长时间。
苏灿给他擦完脸，视线落在他满脸的鬍子上，暂时先不管这个问题。
她看了看这个土炕，下面铺了一层草垫子，上面又铺了张破凉蓆，再上面是一条味道极臭的破军被。
想来应该是这段时间，陆战东的排泄物弄到了床上，再加上没人清理。
屋里的味道好闻就怪了。
真的难以想像，这段时间这个男人和三个孩子是怎么熬过来的。
这特么还是人住的地方吗？
要想除掉这个屋子里的臭味，她必须得从根上清理。
苏灿想了想，伸手去拿盖在陆战东身上的破床单，被他一把摁住了。
“別动！”
因为自己的双腿动不了，大小便都只能在床上解决。他的身体重，两个儿子搬不动，每天都只能等大哥或者二哥来帮忙，时间一长，二哥便把他的裤子给扔了。
现在盖在身上的，是他最后一块遮羞布。
苏灿愣了愣，接著反应过来，“咳咳……那个，你不会没穿裤子吧？”
说这话的时候，她自己的脸都红了。
前世工作忙，她连个男朋友都没谈过，男人最隱私的地方，她还真没见过。
看他不回应自己，再看看他紧绷的表情，苏灿便明白自己这是说对了。
她想了一下，看著他开门见山的道：“屋子里的味道太臭了，我现在既然是你媳妇，就必须把家里弄的乾净一些。我得先把你的身体擦乾净，然后再打扫其他的地方。你看这样行不行？这条毛巾以后就留给你擦身体，我把你扶起来。你自己能够的著地方全都擦一遍，擦完了你就叫我。我帮你换水，你看怎么样？”
陆战东半信半疑地看著她，並没有直接回答她的问题，而是看著她平静地道，“你觉得自己能坚持几天？”

苏灿无奈地看著他，“你管我能坚持几天？住在这种又臭又脏的地方，你能受的了，孩子们能受的了吗？能干净一天你就得乾净一天，其他的想那么多干啥？”
说完不等他回应，自己先把毛巾放到水盆里洗了洗，然后拧了个半干递给他。
接著再把那盆水端到了炕边他能够的著的地方。
“我现在要把你扶起来了，我可告诉你哦，我脾气不太好，你要是不自己洗的话，一会我就亲自上手了。你要是再拒绝，我就把这盆水直接泼到你身上。”
陆战东有些意外地看著她，这女孩子的脾气跟她的身体还真是一样彪悍。
其实他只是担心，这个胖女孩给了他们一家四口希望，再突然离开。
他倒是没什么，就怕孩子们再受一次打击。
“好，你扶我起来吧。”
看他终於被自己说服，苏灿上前把他扶了起来。
“好了你就叫我，你先用清水擦，一会儿我给你拿肥皂。”
苏灿说完便出了门。
陆战东这次倒是听她的话，很配合的用毛巾擦了身体。
content_en:
Hearing the noise in the house just now, he thought that the woman would definitely leave after a while, but he didn't expect that she would fetch water to wipe her face.
But he didn't speak, just looked at her silently.
The sudden whim was nothing surprising to him, it just depended on how long she could hold on.
After Su Can wiped his face, his eyes fell on his beard, and he ignored the problem for the time being.
She looked at the earthen kang. There was a straw mat underneath, a shabby mat on top, and a very smelly shabby army quilt on top.
It seems that it was during this time that Lu Zhandong's excrement got onto the bed, and no one cleaned it up.
It's strange that the smell in the house is so good.
It’s really hard to imagine how this man and his three children survived this period of time.
Is this still a place where people live?
To get rid of the stench in this house, she had to clean it from the root.
Su Can thought for a while, then reached out to pick up the torn sheets covering Lu Zhandong, but he held him down.
"Don't move!"
Because I can't move my legs, I can only relieve myself on the bed. His body was heavy and his two sons could not move it. They had to wait for the eldest brother or the second brother to come to help every day. As time went by, the second brother threw away his pants.
What is covering him now is his last fig leaf.
Su Can was stunned for a moment, then reacted, "Ahem... Well, you're not wearing pants, are you?"
When she said this, her face turned red.
She was busy with work in her previous life, and she never even had a boyfriend. She had never seen the most private parts of a man.
Seeing that he didn't respond to her and looking at his tense expression, Su Can knew that he was right.
She thought for a moment, looked at him and said straight to the point: "The smell in the house is too stinky. Since I am your wife now, I must make the house cleaner. I have to wipe your body clean first, and then clean other places. Do you think this is okay? I will leave this towel for you to wipe your body from now on, and I will help you up. You can wipe all the places you can, and you can call me after wiping. I will change the water for you. What do you think?"
Lu Zhandong looked at her doubtfully, and did not answer her question directly. Instead, he looked at her and said calmly, "How many days do you think you can last?"
Su Can looked at him helplessly, "How long do you care how long I can hold on? Living in such a smelly and dirty place, can you bear it? Can the children bear it? If you can be clean for one day, you have to be clean for one day. Why do you think so much about other things?"
After saying that, without waiting for his response, he put the towel in the basin and washed it, then wring it half dry and handed it to him.
Then he brought the basin of water to the edge of the kang where he could hold it.
"I'm going to help you up now. Let me tell you, I have a bad temper. If you don't wash yourself, I will do it myself in a while. If you refuse again, I will pour this basin of water directly on you."
Lu Zhandong looked at her with some surprise. This girl's temper was as strong as her body.
In fact, he was just worried that this fat girl would leave suddenly after giving hope to their family of four.
He was fine, he was just afraid that the children would be hit again.
"Okay, help me up."
Seeing that he was finally convinced by himself, Su Can stepped forward and helped him up.
"Okay, just call me. You wipe it with water first, and I will get you soap later."
After Su Can finished speaking, he went out.
Lu Zhandong listened to her words this time and cooperated by wiping his body with a towel.
